description: Independent verbatim spans claim separate commas, and repeated channel requests reuse each span (engine §11).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage chars
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {pair}
%rule pair $a:a "," $b:b
%emits $a, $b
%rule a :: A | "a"
%rule b :: B | "b"
%stage words
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text {pair}
%rule pair $a:A $b:B
%emits $a := $a.verbatim-text :- $a.verbatim-text, $b
```
